description: Towering terra firme forest, blackwater creeks, and floodplain that spends half the year underwater. Food hangs everywhere — if you know what you're looking at. The forest is not empty; it is a garden that forgot its gardeners.
hazards: flash floods in the wet season — the várzea goes under
fer-de-lance and other pit vipers in the leaf litter
mosquitoes at dusk (itchy; the giant ones carry worse)
jaguar near water at dusk and dawn
name: Amazon Rainforest

dry.note: Rivers drop. Fish crowd the shrinking pools — the hungry season for the forest, the harvest season for you.

wet.note: Rain most afternoons. Rivers flood the forest and the fish swim among the trees. Fruit everywhere; game dispersed.
